video_title: Steph, Giannis or Spida: Who would be LeBron's best running mate to WIN IT ALL? 🏆 | First Take

quotes.speaker: David Dennis Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Why Donovan Mitchell is not the best fit for LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: I don't think LeBron James wants to go someplace and steal a championship culture.
quotes.quote: First, I am going to throw Donovan Mitchell out there. No disrespect to him, but I don't put him in the same category as Giannis Antetokounmpo and Stephen Curry. Partially because I don't think LeBron James wants to go someplace and steal a championship culture. He just got through doing that with the Lakers. I don't think that is how he wants to end his career. While Giannis may be the best player out of the bunch right now, I just don't think that is a good fit schematically, offensively.

quotes.speaker: David Dennis Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Steph Curry is the ideal running mate for LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: Steph Curry for me is the best fit for LeBron James.
quotes.quote: Stephen Curry for me is the best fit for LeBron James. It is just the fact that these two guys work hand and fist together, as we have seen. It just works well. The offense is already ready-made. They have played together. They know each other back and forth. They know just by studying each other playing against one another, they know what they are going to do on the court before the other person does it. These guys know how to play together, they know how to win championships against each other, and gold medals with each other. Then add in the Draymond Green element of this.

quotes.speaker: Vincent Goodwill
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James at 42 cannot carry the heavy lifting
quotes.excerpt: At 42, 43 years old, how much heavy lifting do you want to have to do?
quotes.quote: My thing with LeBron James is at 42, 43 years old, how much heavy lifting do you want to have to do? If you go and play with Stephen Curry and Draymond Green, you have to go be the best version of LeBron James that you can afford to be. If you go to Miami, they have a better version of that in Giannis Antetokounmpo. They have a guy in Bam Adebayo that is one of the best two-way players in the league. LeBron has increasingly become a better jump shooter off the ball as he has aged. That is one of the things that has allowed him to be a more effective ball player playing with Anthony Davis, playing with Luka Doncic.

quotes.speaker: Vincent Goodwill
quotes.summary_phrase: The Miami Heat are the best fit for LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: They know how to find the value players, the Gabe Vincents, the Max Struses.
quotes.quote: Playing with the Miami Heat, the franchise, it feels better to me. They know how to build out a roster. They have done this before with LeBron James, they have done it with Jimmy Butler. They are doing it right now. They know how to find the value players, the Gabe Vincents, the Max Struses. They found Tim Hardaway Jr., a six-man-of-the-year candidate on a value contract. So whether it is one year or two years, I feel like easing the burden off of what LeBron has to do on a daily basis is key here to keep him upright.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Steph Curry and LeBron James are the ultimate generational duo
quotes.excerpt: It has got to be Steph. We are talking about two generational players whose games match.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: The answer to this question, with no slight to Donovan Mitchell or Giannis or anybody, it has got to be Steph. We are talking about two generational players whose games match.

text_blocks.speaker: Vincent Goodwill
text_blocks.text: I am thoroughly enjoying Vince trying to speak into existence LeBron in Miami.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Why the Cleveland Cavaliers might be a better fit than Miami
quotes.excerpt: I think Cleveland might be the better fit honestly, especially if they are willing to trade Evan Mobley.
quotes.quote: I think Cleveland might be the better fit honestly, especially if they are willing to trade Evan Mobley. But I am addicted to the idea of watching Steph and LeBron play together for a season.

quotes.speaker: Vincent Goodwill
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James and Steph Curry as rivals is better for history
quotes.excerpt: This would be weirder to me than to watch Kevin Durant join a Golden State.
quotes.quote: This would be weirder to me than to watch Kevin Durant join a Golden State because there was no connective tissue with those guys. LeBron and Steph went from rocking with each other when Steph was at Davidson in college and everything and LeBron going to see him at the Final Four, to Steph becoming great enough for LeBron to hate him and despise him. Steph had to realize that he had to recalibrate his brain because he was not a genuine threat to LeBron James. I want to see that relationship complete its arc where they are forever peers and friendly rivals as opposed to friends on the same team.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The rivalry between LeBron James and Steph Curry will continue regardless
quotes.excerpt: If they don't team up, the rivalry will continue on like November 12th and March 13th.
quotes.quote: The LeBron-Steph every time they play is great, but if they don't team up, the rivalry will continue on like November 12th and March 13th. These will be the games they play for the rest of their careers. I don't think they are going to play meaningful basketball against each other apart. The only pathway for them to do to play meaningful basketball on the court together is on a team together.
